11. Peoples and races

Partial Variants and Races – Specification; Lore §2, §12.

11.1 The default races (data/races/default.json)

Six races, each one definition read by three modules: species (culture), prefers (where it begins), body (RPG and magic), language (body plan or a fixed preset).

RaceMassLifeCold limitNotes
Human65 kg70 y8 °Cthe reference; river plains and temperate lowlands
Dwarf80 kg200 y−4 °Cmountains and underground; builders and smiths
Elf55 kg400 y−4 °Cold forests; slow breeding; keen senses; mana_sensitive
Orc90 kg50 y−10 °Cfast breeding, hardy, warlike
Troll280 kg120 y−18 °Cthe cold high country; intellect 0.85
Ogre250 kg90 y−8 °Cheavy, in small clans; intellect 0.8

Sentient monsters (data/races/monsters.json, proposals): Goblins, Fishmen, Giants.

Several races in one world, built: each species founds peoples where it is at home, and peoples of different species compete for land but do not assimilate or blend. A state ruling another species leaves it a substrate. Daughter cultures keep their mother’s species.

Subraces, built: cultures of one species grouped by their land (highland, northern, tropical, desert, coastal, forest, steppe, riverine, lowland), with bodies shifted by Bergmann’s and Allen’s rules.

Still to build Per-race hand-offs, aquatic and subterranean peoples

  • The hand-off’s domesticates, dangers and disease burden are judged against the first race only (human by default; Two Defaults §1). A troll ought to keep different beasts.
  • Fishmen are modelled as a land people of the shores, because there is no aquatic way of life.
  • Dwarves prefer underground but have no subterranean way of life.

11.2 Monsters, beasts and beings

  • Beasts: the bestiary of the biology module (evolved worlds) or the created species (the Creation), converted to creature statistics.
  • Constructs and spirits (beings.ts), built: golems, automata, guardians and illusions in great ruins and colleges of magic; ghosts at great calamities and battles; elementals at hot spots; spirits of place and ancestors' shades at sacred places. Without magic they are tales only.
